title: Hasse Obstructions to Rationality for Special Fourfolds
summary: For every nonempty Hassett divisor $\mathcal C_d$ parameterizing special cubic fourfolds, we consider the quaternion class $β_d=(d/2,-3)$ in the two-torsion Brauer group. We prove that if a Hodge-general member of ${C}_d$ is rational then $β_d=0$ -- or, equivalently, that Huybrechts' twisted-K3 condition $(**')$ holds. Consequently, a very general member of $\mathcal C_d$ is irrational if $β_d\ne0$. Thus, a very general cubic fourfold containing a smooth cubic scroll or a Veronese surface is irrational, and hence so is a very general Küchle fourfold of type $(\mathrm{c7})$. We also obtain an…
